claims.verbatim:
Steamship Scotia[?] (Br), Judkins, Liverpool Aug 25 and
Queenstown 26th[?], at 4 PM, with mdse and passengers, to E
Cunard. Aug 27[?], lat 51 28, lon 15, passed bark Fame, of Dub-
lin, bound E; 28th, 5 PM, lat 51 20, lon 18 22, passed an In-
man steamer bound E; Sept 1, 8:30 AM, lat 47 04, lon 50 23,
passed brig Mary[?], of St Johns, NF, bound W; 3d, 3:30 AM,
lat 42 29, lon 6[?]59[?], passed an Inman steamer bound E; same
day, 7 AM, lat 42 16, lon 63 39, passed steamship Teutonia,
bound E.
